note: Story-relevant item IDs (Revision 2). systems/items.json is authoritative for stats; new ids here need Quartermaster entries (see MIGRATION_V1_TO_V2.md).

items.gas_can: 5 gal gasoline. Ch1 choice: Pruitt's oxygen concentrator, the house generator, or the drive to Yerington (ch01_gas_choice).
items.mech_tools: Braith's flight-line tool roll (Snap-On). Tradeable to Gil in Ch1 (returned in Ch3 if you helped). Without it Ch4 black start is slower.
items.diesel_jug: 5 gal diesel. Generator fuel; barter staple (Mo, Boone).
items.canned_food: Food. Restores satiety. Feeds Wraith. Peace offering (Lunds, recovery detail, Salt, Viaduct ambush).
items.candles: Light at night; minor warmth indoors. Rourke trades them for stories.
items.water_dirty: Marina water (later: melted snow). Boil at a water station (ch01_water_station) before drinking.
items.water_clean: Boiled or cistern water. No RAD.
items.pruitt_scarf: Scent item. Wraith TRACKs Mr. Pruitt from it (Ch1 companion tutorial).
items.pharmacy_bag: Clinic supplies for Lolo (gauze, amoxicillin). Searched at the Ch2 checkpoint unless Haas is bribed or trusts you.
items.ration_card: Authority ration card. Weekly food at the convention center; talks past watch patrols. Scrip in Act I–II.
items.priority_card: Essential-worker card: double rations + Authority travel pass. Earned in Ch2 (registry, Ames's letter, or a report).
items.cigarettes: Currency. Bribes Cpl. Haas; Dutch and Boone want them.
items.firewood: Fuel for fires; warmth stops. Draws Tallmen (heat).
items.wool_blanket: Warmth. Required to talk down a husk.
items.hand_radio: Receives Augie, the Night Owl and the Switchboard.
items.batteries: Radio/flashlight power. Annie and Dutch want them.
items.flashlight: Light. Sustained beam pushes Tallmen back. Can be left with Salt (Ch4).
items.relay_kit: Protective relay for Galena Unit 1. From the Authority, the Floor, or the Compact; otherwise bypass (riskier).
items.walt_keys: Galena Station keys and lockout tags.
items.vet_kit: Treats Wraith (clears wraith_injured). Annie, Ames or Lolo can supply one.
items.signal_fuse: Rail signal cabinet part (Ch5 canyon crossing).
items.flare: Light. Scares dogs and coyotes; drives Tallmen back. Siege essential.
items.grain_sack: Display: 'ration pallet'. Bulk warehouse food; tradeable.
items.ironwood_id: Ruiz's ID. One free pass through an Ironwood checkpoint or talk-down (Ch7 recovery detail, Ch9 picket).
items.iodide_tablets: Potassium iodide. Slows RAD gain; needed to talk down a husk.
items.mask_filter: Gas-mask filter. Loads into Braith's Air Force gas mask (has_gas_mask, from Ch8 start). FILTER % on HUD. Some of Boone's are expired.
items.antibiotics: Cures infection. Annie's seed library; Ames.
items.whiskey: Barter. Boone and Rourke want it.
items.ross_letter: Ross's letter on a feed receipt (Ch3). Journal item.
items.gpu_cart: -86 aircraft ground power cart, 90 kW, from the Air Guard ramp (Ch4). Black-starts Galena; powers the Annex maglocks (Ch7).
items.control_cards: Hardened PLC/control modules from Annex cage four (Ch7). Restart Galena after the December bursts.
items.lamp_kit: Hardened floodlight heads from the Annex. Builds the Ch10 lamp line (lamp_line_built).
items.annex_log: Tolliver's 92-day guard log + partial Annex manifest (wing B redacted/flooded) + one water-swollen page: 'TISSUE INTEGRATION, FIELD TRIAL: ███. HOST BEHAVIOR RETAINED: ███.' Lore; foreshadows the Ch8 Hollows.
items.rumor: Info token. Currency with Rourke and Dutch. From Augie, the Night Owl, travelers.
items.spur_chip: Silver Spur casino chip. The Floor's scrip in Act II (trader_floor).
